title: My Presentation at Italian BC Day 2026 (7 Maggio 2026 – Milan, Italy): What I Talked About
summary: A speaker shares their experience presenting at Italian BC Day 2026 in Milan, discussing why they started their technical blog to share knowledge with the BC community worldwide and how they maintain high-frequency publishing through continuous learning and community feedback.
key_points: Blog started to share knowledge and solve challenges faced by BC professionals together with the global community
Writing itself serves as the author's essential learning process, deepening technical understanding
Community feedback and the feeling of connection with readers is the primary motivation for consistent high-frequency publishing
Complex technology is organized in accessible format so individual learning can contribute to others' success

quotes.text: The reason I started my website and blog was to share knowledge and solve the challenges faced by BC professionals and users worldwide together.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the core motivation for creating technical content and the collaborative approach to problem-solving

quotes.text: Writing itself is my essential learning process.
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows how content creation doubles as professional development, not just knowledge transfer

quotes.text: My small individual learning can lead to someone else's success somewhere in the world. Expanding this positive chain is my greatest motivation.
quotes.why_it_matters: Captures the philosophy of paying forward community support and creating cascading value
